issues.description: Reports describe removed or changed features and a degraded interface after updates, with one separate Android Auto voice command issue.
Music playback stops, pauses, or fails to start, sometimes requiring users to restart the app, switch tracks, or reinstall it.
Reports describe songs failing to play as selected, unexpected track choices or repetition, and playback advancing or becoming silent.
Most examples express general dislike without a specific download problem; one reports the app appearing offline while the user is connected.
issues.issue_name: Vague negative reactions to the app

issues.description: Reports describe downloads that fail, take too long, or disappear or save to the wrong storage location.
